sections.title: Letter name ell
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (ell) /ɛl/. Its main sound is in the word (ló) /ˈloː/, which means horse. This letter has only one sound in standard speech.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Press the tip of your tongue against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Let the air pass smoothly along both sides of your tongue. Use your voice while you breathe out. Put your fingers on your throat to feel it vibrate.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes one steady sound. You hear it at the start of (ló) /ˈloː/. Written twice, it becomes a long sound, like in the word (toll) /ˈtolː/.

sections.title: Avoiding English habits
paragraphs: Do not swallow the sound at the end of a word like in ball. Keep the back of your tongue down and flat. Keep the tongue tip firm on the ridge, exactly like in the English word light.
